verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a native bulk-action feature, such as multi-select to delete, archive, or move many chats or files at once. Bulk work is only indirectly possible: API keys let external code call the same endpoints the UI uses, so users can script batch operations, and the AI can fan work out to parallel sub-agents or one agent per worktree. Missing for 10: native bulk select/edit/delete across items, documented batch API endpoints, any hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
